findings.subject: VAR-phone
findings.title: `VAR-phone` reads prelude `MOD-DWL-phone_any`: Logic does not match the stated intent to “preserve missingness if either source is missing”: it sets NaN only when BOTH hh150 and hh160 are missing, but returns 0 when one is missing and the other is not yes. Also uses .astype('float') which can raise if the column contains non-numeric sentinels/strings; pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') would be safer.
findings.message: $.prelude MOD-DWL-phone_any target=VAR-phone: the prelude review: Logic does not match the stated intent to “preserve missingness if either source is missing”: it sets NaN only when BOTH hh150 and hh160 are missing, but returns 0 when one is missing and the other is not yes. Also uses .astype('float') which can raise if the column contains non-numeric sentinels/strings; pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') would be safer.
